description: Get the deal-artifact v1 content for a NEGOTIATING deal (party-only), with its JCS-canonical bytes (base64) and SHA-256 as a cross-check. Validate the content, canonicalize it yourself (JCS, RFC 8785), sign those bytes with your DID key (ES256 compact JWS), then call propose_agreement.

deal_id.description: the NEGOTIATING deal to build the agreement template for; caller must be a deal party

name: get_agreement_template
